C24_validation_independence.note: this audit read VALIDATION outcomes, which is exactly the role the frozen ordering assigns to a development split. It applied only predeclared gates and changed no scientific parameter.

C26_h1_scientific_testability.assessment: H1 IS SCIENTIFICALLY TESTABLE ON THIS DATASET, subject to closing the measurement gap recorded below.

evidence: MEASURED PRE-DATA HEADROOM AGREES. The executable headroom requalification v6 (AUTHORITATIVE_PRE_DATA_HEADROOM, 150 cells, 450 policy executions, detached-reproduced with 0 category mismatches) measured F3 = BOTH_FAIL 15/15, F4 = BOTH_FAIL 12 + INVALID 3, F6 = BOTH_FAIL 15/15. v2 and v3 agree. No requalification at any version ever measured a LINE_ONLY_SUCCESS cell in F3 or F4.

EXACT INDEPENDENT REPLICATION. TRAIN and VALIDATION both report zero positive aggregates on both candidate topologies for F3, F4 and F6, on fully disjoint layout sets (20 vs 10, overlap 0) and disjoint source episodes.
POSITIVE CONTROL. The committed F1 control produced 20/20 COMPACT positives through the identical frozen Target V4 code path, so the label path is not degenerate.

ACQUISITION BIAS RULED OUT. The TRAIN positive rate is flat across all six source policies (0.3065-0.3296) and across all five selection ordinals (0.2855-0.3551); there is no late-ordinal collapse and no policy dependence.

NO FROZEN GATE IS VIOLATED. No gate in docs/RVT_RECOVERABILITY_LABEL_AUDIT_GATES.md and no field in the H1 requirement map requires any family to contain positive Recoverability labels. All three families clear gate 4 comfortably (F3 111, F4 77, F6 131 against a minimum of 30).
GENERATION INVALID IS ZERO. 0 actual and 0 fake GENERATION_INVALID in both splits, so the negatives are scientific VALID_TASK_NEGATIVE, not masked failures.

verdict_text: Audit incomplete. Every scientific question this phase poses is answered from committed authority and the F3/F4/F6 scenario tension is resolved, but the production target holding the sealed row payloads and stage ledgers was unreachable for the entire measurement window, so several required recomputations from the actual data, and frozen label-audit gate 7 in particular, could not be performed.
